name: spring-scene
summary: One shape that never cuts: it grows, shrinks and recolours on a timetable, content swaps in and out on it, the camera and a cursor follow; every change a closed-form spring, so a timetable edit is a data edit.
use: state(params, t) → g; canvas(ctx, g, params, drawLayer) or dom({ world, shape, layers, cursor }, g, params). The tracks are built once a params object: change a copy, not the object.

slots.name: center
slots.text: where the camera centres the world on screen, CSS px

slots.name: SH
slots.text: the shape's states by name: width, height, corner radius (capped at half the shape), colour (#rrggbb) and the camera's scale in that state

slots.name: start
slots.text: the state at t = 0 (a key of SH)

slots.name: SEQ
slots.text: the timetable: [seconds, state] in time order; each change is one spring from where the value is

slots.name: spring
slots.text: the shape's spring: a preset of lib/motion.js SPRINGS, or [w rad/s, zeta]; morph is 15 rad/s at zeta 0.84, about 3 % overshoot

slots.name: camSpring
slots.text: the camera's spring (critically damped by default: it never overshoots)

slots.name: intro
slots.text: when the shape springs in from 55 % (null: on screen from the first frame)

slots.name: shapePress
slots.text: times the shape is pressed (a 3.5 % squeeze and back), for a click that lands on it

slots.name: layers
slots.text: content on the shape: [{ id, tin, tout, anchor: c|l|t, o: { din, lin, lout, blur } }]; each swaps in after a beat and out fast, so two never overlap

slots.name: cursor
slots.text: { keys: [[t, x, y], …] in world px, clicks: [t], drags: [[t0, t1]] }: a hand's path on a slight arc, a press at each click

slots.name: domBlur
slots.text: let the DOM painter blur a layer as it swaps (playbook/03 §4 animates only transform, opacity and clip-path in the DOM; the canvas painter always blurs)

provenance.note: the scene's state and its DOM wiring; components/NOTICE.md
